# Bobcorn Developer Portal Context

- Developer portal: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/developers/
- API docs: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/
- CLI maintenance guide: https://github.com/Caldis/bobcorn/blob/master/docs/CLI.md
- Repository agent instructions: https://github.com/Caldis/bobcorn/blob/master/AGENTS.md
- OpenAPI spec: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/openapi.json

For automation, prefer the local CLI and `.icp` project files. For public website metadata, use the read-only endpoints described in OpenAPI.
